description: minimumReleaseAge is deliberately datasource-wide: it governs the pins below and every datasource this config may grow to manage

security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm is ignored: its 3-day npm rule would override the global minimumReleaseAge. Its exemptions for timestamp-less npm update types (pin, replacement, rollback) are deliberately not kept: fail closed, those PRs open with a forever-pending, non-required stability status and wait for a human, as such updates already do for every other datasource
NOTE: an upstream rename of security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm would silently re-admit it

packageRules.description: hugo-extended is intentionally pinned; updated manually via `npm run update:hugo`
Redoc 3 moves the script to bundle/redoc.js (2.x: bundles/redoc.standalone.js); the redoc shortcode hardcodes the 2.x path, so a 3.x bump is a manual migration

customManagers.description: Update the script-dependency versions pinned in the theme config
